details:
This update for librsvg fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-96889: Use-after-free when XML includes have duplicated entities (bsc#1282612).

Changes for librsvg:

- Update to version 2.56.6:

 + This is a security release for bug #1241, RUSTSEC-2026-0305 /
 CVE-2026-96889 / bsc#1282612:
 - glgo#GNOME/librsvg#1241: Fix use-after-free when there are
 duplicate XML entities in nested Xinclude documents. Thanks to
 Rafael B. Dias for reporting this in detail.
 - Dependency updates: lopdf for RUSTSEC-2026-0187, crossbeam-epoch for
 RUSTSEC-2026-0204, time for RUSTSEC-2026-0009.
 - The minimum supported Rust version (MSRV) is 1.89.0.
